subject: Input Data size of HBase Table in RHIPE

messages.author: 9db4061bc19b5b09
messages.subject: Input Data size of HBase Table in RHIPE
parts:
Hi,

I am trying  to fetch data from HBase, using custom TableInputFormat, I am sending <Key,Value> to MapReduce job.
I am trying to run MapReduce via RHIPE. I am facing problem to know exact size of input file.
HDFS_BYTES_READ just give size of .META size, it doesn't give whole table size.  How can I know Input size of HBASE Table in RHIPE?
 


Regards
Bikash

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Input Data size of HBase Table in RHIPE
parts:
In your input format, create a counter of the bytes you've read (i.e. size of the key and value)
and add them to get an approximation of the of the total bytes read from HBASE.


And if you send raw bytes to RHIPE, then you can do the same via rhcounter on the RHIPE side.
But it's a few lines in java, so you might as well save time and do it java(inputformat side)

Cheers
Saptarshi

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Input Data size of HBase Table in RHIPE
parts:
Thank you very much.

I have one question.  When I run MapReduce in RHIPE, via HBASE as source. The input data read-write is taking more than 30 minutes to read almost 149,119 records.
Which I debug, I found this line of code is taking much more time. May be because it is reading custom input format.
 https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/code/java/org/godhuli/rhipe/RHMRHelper.java#L329-L341

But some map task with same number of record are fast enough. If it was issue with custom input format, then every map task should have same nature of behavior.

I run same code, with same amount of data on my local machine in pseudo-distributed mode with 5 RegionServer. It took less than 4 minute for overall execution.
I guess the behavior on the cluster should be much more faster.

Do you have any idea about such issue?


Thank you
Bikash

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Input Data size of HBase Table in RHIPE
parts:
Hi,

Issue is solved. The issue was because of custom input format<K,V>.
I need to set caching on my scan pointer.
scan.setBatch(batch);
scan.setCaching(caching);

Thanks
Bikash
